GOAL: one continuous blind-player run per replicate through ALL scenes in one session, so every scene gets an exit label (play or timer). Today the spec plays one scene (E2E_BLIND_SCENE, default 1A); for a later scene it first walks the earlier scenes with a scripted player. Add a mode E2E_BLIND_SCENE=all where the blind player plays every scene in pacing.sceneOrder, 1A first, in the SAME session. Behaviour for a single scene id (including the default) must stay exactly as it is.

BUILD:
1. In blind-player.spec.js move the per-scene turn loop into a function playScene({ sceneId, openingText, counter, ... }) that returns the same run record the spec builds today (analyseRun fields, commands, prompts, turns, turn_count, opening_text, scene). The single-scene path calls it once. The all path: start the session once (startSceneSession), take the opening text from `.entry-output`, then for each scene call playScene. When a scene's transition fires, the transition turn's own narration text (segments of kind narration/action/dialogue/speech, which include the next scene's entry text) is the next scene's openingText. Use sceneEntry, nextSceneEntry, firstStep and later from the affordance map for the CURRENT scene each time. Ceiling per scene stays min(20, handoff target_turn + 2).
2. E2E_BLIND_SCENES (optional, comma list such as 1A,1B) caps the scene list in all mode; every id must exist in pacing.sceneOrder and the list must be a prefix of it, else throw. Used for the smoke run.
3. Billed-endpoint guards: keep the per-scene model-call cap of 20 (a fresh counter per scene) and add a hard total cap of 200 askPlayer calls per replicate (a shared total counter; throw a clear error when hit). Keep the staging-only guard. Test timeout becomes 60 minutes in all mode (20 minutes stays for a single scene).
4. A timer exit does NOT stop the run; the next scene is played from the state the engine left. Stop the replicate (record why in the report as stopped_reason) only if: a scene is rejected 3 times in a row (as today), or a scene has no transition by its ceiling, or the last scene is finished. A scene with no transition by its ceiling still gets its run record.
5. Report shape. With E2E_BLIND_REPLICATE_INDEX=n (existing mechanism, replicatePlan in merge-blind-player.js) the spec writes artifacts/e2e-blind-player-r<n>.json as today. In all mode each replicate entry is { replicate, scenes: [ run record per scene, each with its scene id ], stopped_reason }, and the report is { story_id, scene: "all", replicates, by_scene: { <sceneId>: aggregate(runs of that scene across replicates) } }. Single-scene reports keep their current shape exactly. Add a helper in blind-player.js (for example flattenScenes / aggregateByScene) so the spec and the merge share one implementation, and make formatMarkdown print one block or row per scene in all mode.
6. merge-blind-player.js: mergeReports must handle reports with scene "all": concatenate replicates (renumbered), recompute by_scene across replicates, keep markdown. Reports for one single scene merge exactly as before. Mixed scene values still throw.
7. digest.py: for a report with scene "all", print one row per scene: exit cause per replicate (play/timer/none), transition turn per replicate, the timer turn, play_exit_rate, and for each affordance the first-shown turn per replicate, then the number of replicates that stopped early. Old single-scene reports must still print exactly as before. Add pytest cases to tests/test_affordance_digest.py (new all-scene report, old report).
8. NEW scripts/ringer/affordance/scene-affordance-l2-all-live.sh <replicates> <scenes>: copy scene-affordance-l2-parallel-live.sh, but run with E2E_BLIND_SCENE=all and E2E_BLIND_SCENES=<scenes> (second argument; empty or the word 'all' means no cap on the list). The same Railway turn-cap raise and restore, health wait, one Playwright process per replicate, merge, copy to /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/affordance-live-all, digest. Pass --timeout=3600000 to playwright (check that flag exists in the installed Playwright; otherwise rely on test.setTimeout). Refuse when replicates is not 1 to 3. The script must pass `bash -n`.
